# Motion logo reveal

The motion-logo-reveal recipe: a dot sparks into a brand-coloured line, the logo springs up from behind it, a ring pulse marks the landing and the tagline settles in below.

- Type: Motion logo reveal
- Skill: `magnifito-promo`
- Engine: `motion`
- Output: 1920x1080, 4 s, silent
- Video: [`../videos/s16-motion-logo-reveal.mp4`](../videos/s16-motion-logo-reveal.mp4)

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Use the magnifito-promo skill to make a 4 second 16:9 logo sting for Magnifito, a Bulgarian digital marketing agency, in the motion-logo-reveal style only: our logo (assets/magnifito-logo.svg) rises from a brand-coloured line, with the tagline "Digital marketing with heart and value." below. Use the motion engine. Brand colours are warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #ae8c72, #f0eadf), Geist for type, English on screen.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- s16-motion-logo-reveal
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/s16-motion-logo-reveal/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
mgvideo render . --format 16:9 --force
```

The finished file is `runs/*/final_output_*.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
